test.en-tha: กฎการเคลื่อนที่ของนิวตัน ที่กำหนดโดยเซอร์ไอแซก นิวตันในผลงานชิ้นเอก Principia Mathematica ปี 1687 เป็นรากฐานของกลศาสตร์คลาสสิกและปฏิวัติความเข้าใจของเราเกี่ยวกับการเคลื่อนที่ทางกายภาพ. กฎข้อแรกระบุว่าวัตถุที่อยู่นิ่งจะคงอยู่นิ่ง และวัตถุที่เคลื่อนที่จะคงเคลื่อนที่ด้วยความเร็วคงที่ เว้นแต่จะถูกกระทำโดยแรงภายนอก แนะนำแนวคิดเรื่องความเฉื่อย. กฎข้อที่สองกำหนดให้ความเร่งของวัตถุแปรผันตรงกับแรงลัพธ์ที่กระทำต่อวัตถุ และแปรผันผกผันกับมวลของวัตถุ แสดงทางคณิตศาสตร์เป็น F = ma. กฎข้อที่สามประกาศว่าทุกการกระทำจะมีปฏิกิริยาที่เท่ากันและตรงข้าม อธิบายว่าแรงเกิดขึ้นเป็นคู่เสมอและทำให้เราเข้าใจปรากฏการณ์ตั้งแต่การเดินไปจนถึงการขับเคลื่อนจรวด ทำให้กฎเหล่านี้เป็นเครื่องมือที่ขาดไม่ได้สำหรับวิศวกรรมศาสตร์ ดาราศาสตร์ และแทบทุกสาขาของฟิสิกส์ประยุกต์.
test.en-arb: قوانين نيوتن للحركة، التي صاغها السير إسحاق نيوتن في تحفته عام 1687 برينسيبيا ماثيماتيكا، تشكل أساس الميكانيكا الكلاسيكية وثورت فهمنا للحركة الفيزيائية. القانون الأول ينص على أن الجسم الساكن يبقى ساكناً والجسم المتحرك يبقى متحركاً بسرعة ثابتة ما لم يؤثر عليه قوة خارجية، مقدماً مفهوم القصور الذاتي. القانون الثاني يؤسس أن تسارع الجسم يتناسب طردياً مع القوة المحصلة المؤثرة عليه وعكسياً مع كتلته، معبراً عنه رياضياً كـ F = ma. القانون الثالث يعلن أنه لكل فعل رد فعل مساوٍ له في المقدار ومضاد له في الاتجاه، موضحاً كيف تحدث القوى دائماً في أزواج وممكناً فهمنا للظواهر من المشي إلى دفع الصواريخ، مما يجعل هذه القوانين أدوات لا غنى عنها للهندسة وعلم الفلك وتقريباً كل مجال في الفيزياء التطبيقية.
test.en-tur: Newton'un Hareket Yasaları, Sir Isaac Newton tarafından 1687 başyapıtı Principia Mathematica'da formüle edilen, klasik mekaniğin temelini oluşturur ve fiziksel hareket anlayışımızda devrim yaratmıştır. Birinci Yasa, durgun bir cismin durgun kaldığını ve hareket halindeki bir cismin dış kuvvet uygulanmadığı sürece sabit hızla hareket etmeye devam ettiğini belirtir ve eylemsizlik kavramını sunar. İkinci Yasa, bir cismin ivmesinin üzerine etki eden net kuvvetle doğru orantılı, kütlesiyle ters orantılı olduğunu belirler ve matematiksel olarak F = ma şeklinde ifade edilir. Üçüncü Yasa, her eylem için eşit ve zıt bir tepki olduğunu ilan eder, kuvvetlerin her zaman çiftler halinde meydana geldiğini açıklar ve yürümekten roket itişine kadar olayları anlamamızı sağlar, bu yasaları mühendislik, astronomi ve hemen hemen her uygulamalı fizik alanı için vazgeçilmez araçlar haline getirir.
test.en-kor: 뉴턴의 운동법칙은 아이작 뉴턴 경이 1687년 그의 걸작 프린키피아 마테마티카에서 공식화한 것으로, 고전역학의 기초를 구성하며 물리적 운동에 대한 우리의 이해를 혁명적으로 바꾸었습니다. 제1법칙은 정지한 물체는 정지 상태를 유지하고 운동하는 물체는 외력이 작용하지 않는 한 일정한 속도로 운동을 계속한다고 명시하며, 관성의 개념을 도입했습니다. 제2법칙은 물체의 가속도가 그에 작용하는 알짜힘에 정비례하고 질량에 반비례한다고 확립하며, 수학적으로 F = ma로 표현됩니다. 제3법칙은 모든 작용에 대해 크기가 같고 방향이 반대인 반작용이 있다고 선언하며, 힘이 항상 쌍으로 발생하는 방식을 설명하고 걷기부터 로켓 추진까지의 현상들을 이해할 수 있게 해주어, 이 법칙들을 공학, 천문학, 그리고 거의 모든 응용물리학 분야에서 없어서는 안 될 도구로 만들었습니다.
test.en-hin: Newton's Laws of Motion, जो Sir Isaac Newton द्वारा उनके 1687 के masterwork Principia Mathematica में formulated किए गए, classical mechanics का foundation constitute करते हैं और हमारी physical motion की understanding को revolutionized किया। The First Law states करता है कि rest में एक object rest में stays रहता है और motion में एक object constant velocity के साथ motion में stays रहता है unless external force द्वारा acted upon किया जाए, introducing inertia का concept। The Second Law establishes करता है कि एक object का acceleration उस पर acting net force के directly proportional है और उसकी mass के inversely proportional है, expressed mathematically F = ma के रूप में। The Third Law declares करता है कि हर action के लिए, एक equal और opposite reaction होती है, explaining करता है कि forces हमेशा pairs में occur करते हैं और walking से rocket propulsion तक की phenomena की हमारी understanding को enabling करते हैं, making इन laws को engineering, astronomy, और virtually हर applied physics के field के लिए indispensable tools।
test.en-ben: নিউটনের গতিসূত্র, যা স্যার আইজ্যাক নিউটন তার ১৬৮৭ সালের মাস্টারপিস প্রিন্সিপিয়া ম্যাথমেটিকায় প্রণয়ন করেছিলেন, ধ্রুপদী বলবিদ্যার ভিত্তি স্থাপন করে এবং ভৌত গতি সম্পর্কে আমাদের বোঝাপড়ায় বিপ্লব ঘটায়। প্রথম সূত্র বলে যে স্থির বস্তু স্থির থাকে এবং গতিশীল বস্তু একটি স্থির বেগে গতিশীল থাকে যতক্ষণ না বাহ্যিক বল দ্বারা প্রভাবিত হয়, জড়তার ধারণা প্রবর্তন করে। দ্বিতীয় সূত্র প্রতিষ্ঠা করে যে একটি বস্তুর ত্বরণ তার উপর ক্রিয়াশীল নেট বলের সরাসরি সমানুপাতিক এবং এর ভরের ব্যস্তানুপাতিক, গাণিতিকভাবে F = ma হিসাবে প্রকাশিত। তৃতীয় সূত্র ঘোষণা করে যে প্রতিটি ক্রিয়ার জন্য একটি সমান এবং বিপরীত প্রতিক্রিয়া রয়েছে, ব্যাখ্যা করে যে কীভাবে বলগুলি সর্বদা জোড়ায় ঘটে এবং হাঁটা থেকে রকেট চালনা পর্যন্ত ঘটনাগুলি বুঝতে আমাদের সক্ষম করে, এই আইনগুলিকে প্রকৌশল, জ্যোতির্বিজ্ঞান এবং প্রায় প্রয়োগিত পদার্থবিজ্ঞানের প্রতিটি ক্ষেত্রের জন্য অপরিহার্য সরঞ্জাম করে তোলে।
test.en-tel: Newton's Laws of Motion, Sir Isaac Newton చేత అతని 1687 masterwork Principia Mathematica లో formulated చేయబడినవి, classical mechanics యొక్క foundation ను constitute చేస్తాయి మరియు మన physical motion యొక్క understanding ను revolutionized చేశాయి. The First Law states చేస్తుంది కి rest లో ఉన్న object rest లో stays ఉంటుంది మరియు motion లో ఉన్న object constant velocity తో motion లో stays ఉంటుంది unless external force చేత acted upon అవుతుంది, introducing inertia యొక్క concept ను. The Second Law establishes చేస్తుంది కి ఒక object యొక్క acceleration దానిపై acting net force కు directly proportional ఉంటుంది మరియు దాని mass కు inversely proportional ఉంటుంది, expressed mathematically F = ma గా. The Third Law declares చేస్తుంది కి ప్రతి action కోసం, ఒక equal మరియు opposite reaction ఉంటుంది, explaining చేస్తుంది కి forces ఎల్లప్పుడూ pairs లో occur అవుతాయి మరియు walking నుండి rocket propulsion వరకు phenomena యొక్క మన understanding ను enabling చేస్తాయి, making ఈ laws ను engineering, astronomy, మరియు virtually ప్రతి applied physics field కోసం indispensable tools గా.
test.en-swa: Sheria za Mwendo za Newton, zilizoandaliwa na Sir Isaac Newton katika kazi yake kuu ya 1687 Principia Mathematica, zinaunda msingi wa mekanika ya classical na zilipindua uelewa wetu wa mwendo wa kimwili. Sheria ya Kwanza inasema kuwa kitu kinachopumzika kinabaki kupumzika na kitu kinachohama kinaendelea kuhama kwa kasi isiyobadilika isipokuwa kikihusika na nguvu ya nje, ikianzisha dhana ya kelele. Sheria ya Pili inaimarisha kuwa kasi ya kitu ni sawia moja kwa moja na nguvu halisi inayokiathiri na ni sawia kinyume na uzito wake, ikifafanuliwa kihisabati kama F = ma. Sheria ya Tatu inatangaza kuwa kwa kila tendo, kuna tendo lingine sawa na kinyume chake, ikielezea jinsi nguvu zinavyotokea kila wakati katika jozi na kuwezesha uelewa wetu wa matukio kutoka kutembea hadi kusukuma roketi, na kufanya sheria hizi kuwa zana muhimu kwa uhandisi, uchunguzi wa anga, na karibu kila uwanda wa fizikia iliyotumika.
test.fa: قوانین حرکت نیوتن، که توسط سر آیزاک نیوتن در شاهکار ۱۶۸۷ او «اصول ریاضی» (پرنسیپیا ماتماتیکا) فرمول‌بندی شد، پایه مکانیک کلاسیک را تشکیل می‌دهد و درک ما از حرکت فیزیکی را متحول کرد. قانون اول بیان می‌کند که جسمی که در حالت سکون است در سکون باقی می‌ماند و جسمی که در حرکت است با سرعت ثابت در حرکت باقی می‌ماند، مگر اینکه نیروی خارجی بر آن اثر کند، و مفهوم اینرسی را معرفی می‌کند. قانون دوم تعیین می‌کند که شتاب یک جسم مستقیماً متناسب با نیروی خالص وارد بر آن و معکوساً متناسب با جرم آن است، که از نظر ریاضی به صورت F = ma بیان می‌شود. قانون سوم اعلام می‌کند که برای هر عمل، عکس‌العمل مساوی و مخالف وجود دارد، که توضیح می‌دهد چگونه نیروها همیشه به صورت جفت رخ می‌دهند و درک ما از پدیده‌هایی از راه رفتن تا رانش موشک را امکان‌پذیر می‌کند، و این قوانین را به ابزارهای ضروری برای مهندسی، نجوم و تقریباً هر زمینه فیزیک کاربردی تبدیل می‌کند.
test.tur: Sir Isaac Newton tarafından 1687 tarihli başyapıtı Principia Mathematica'da formüle edilen Newton'un Hareket Yasaları, klasik mekaniğin temelini oluşturur ve fiziksel hareket anlayışımızı devrimleştirmiştir. Birinci Yasa, hareketsiz bir cismin hareketsiz kaldığını ve hareket halindeki bir cismin dış bir kuvvet etkisinde kalmadıkça sabit hızla hareketine devam ettiğini belirtir ve eylemsizlik kavramını tanıtır. İkinci Yasa, bir cismin ivmesinin üzerine etki eden net kuvvetle doğru orantılı, kütlesiyle ters orantılı olduğunu kurar ve matematiksel olarak F = ma şeklinde ifade edilir. Üçüncü Yasa, her etkiye eşit ve zıt bir tepkinin olduğunu bildirir, kuvvetlerin her zaman çiftler halinde ortaya çıktığını açıklar ve yürümekten roket tahrikine kadar olayları anlamamızı sağlayarak bu yasaları mühendislik, astronomi ve uygulamalı fiziğin neredeyse her alanı için vazgeçilmez araçlar haline getirir.
test.ita: Le Leggi del Moto di Newton, formulate da Sir Isaac Newton nella sua opera magistrale del 1687 Principia Mathematica, costituiscono le fondamenta della meccanica classica e rivoluzionarono la nostra comprensione del moto fisico. La Prima Legge stabilisce che un oggetto a riposo rimane a riposo e un oggetto in movimento rimane in movimento con velocità costante a meno che non sia influenzato da una forza esterna, introducendo il concetto di inerzia. La Seconda Legge stabilisce che l'accelerazione di un oggetto è direttamente proporzionale alla forza netta che agisce su di esso e inversamente proporzionale alla sua massa, espressa matematicamente come F = ma. La Terza Legge dichiara che per ogni azione c'è una reazione uguale e opposta, spiegando come le forze si verifichino sempre in coppie e permettendo la nostra comprensione di fenomeni dal camminare alla propulsione a razzo, rendendo queste leggi strumenti indispensabili per l'ingegneria, l'astronomia e virtualmente ogni campo della fisica applicata.
test.zho: 牛顿运动定律由艾萨克·牛顿爵士在其1687年的杰作《自然哲学的数学原理》中提出，构成了经典力学的基础，革命了我们对物理运动的理解。第一定律表明，静止的物体保持静止，运动的物体以恒定速度继续运动，除非受到外力作用，引入了惯性概念。第二定律确定物体的加速度与作用在其上的净力成正比，与其质量成反比，数学表达式为F = ma。第三定律宣告每个作用都有一个相等且相反的反作用，解释了力总是成对出现，使我们能够理解从行走到火箭推进的现象，使这些定律成为工程学、天文学和几乎所有应用物理学领域不可或缺的工具。

test.explanation: Roman general and heir apparent who was one of Rome's most beloved military commanders
test.en: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), born Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged as one of Rome's most celebrated military commanders and the empire's most promising heir apparent during the early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted by his uncle Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned his cognomen through brilliant campaigns against Germanic tribes beyond the Rhine, avenging the devastating defeat at the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest and restoring Roman prestige on the northern frontier. His charismatic leadership, genuine concern for his soldiers, and remarkable oratory skills made him beloved by both the legions and the Roman people, while his marriage to Agrippina the Elder produced nine children, including the future Emperor Caligula. His mysterious death in Antioch at age 33, amid rumors of poisoning by Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, created a political crisis that shook the empire and established him as a tragic hero whose early demise robbed Rome of what many considered its greatest potential leader.
test.en-rus: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), born Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged как один из самых celebrated military commanders Рима и empire's самый promising heir apparent во время early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted своим дядей Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned его cognomen через brilliant campaigns против Germanic tribes beyond Rhine, avenging devastating defeat в Battle of the Teutoburg Forest и restoring Roman prestige на northern frontier. His харизматичное leadership, genuine concern для его soldiers, и remarkable oratory skills сделали его beloved как legions, так и Roman people, while его marriage к Agrippina the Elder произвело девять детей, including будущего Emperor Caligula. His загадочная смерть в Antioch в возрасте 33 лет, amid rumors отравления Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, создала political crisis которая потрясла empire и established его как tragic hero whose раннее demise лишило Rome того, что многие считали его greatest potential leader.
test.en-zho: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), born Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged 作为罗马最著名的军事指挥官之一和帝国最有前途的继承人 during 早期朱里奥-克劳狄王朝. Adopted 被他的叔叔提比略皇帝收养, Germanicus earned 他的绰号通过对莱茵河彼岸日耳曼部落的辉煌战役, avenging 条顿堡森林战役的惨败 and restoring 罗马在北部边境的威望. His 魅力领导力、对士兵的真诚关怀和卓越的演说技巧 made 他深受军团和罗马人民的爱戴, while 他与老阿格里皮娜的婚姻生了九个孩子, including 未来的卡利古拉皇帝. His 33岁时在安条克的神秘死亡, amid 叙利亚总督格奈乌斯·卡尔普尼乌斯·皮索下毒的传言, created 震撼帝国的政治危机 and established 他作为悲剧英雄，其过早死亡夺走了许多人认为的罗马最伟大潜在领袖.
test.en-jpn: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), Nero Claudius Drusus として生まれ, emerged ローマ最も celebrated な military commanders の一人として、そして empire の最も promising な heir apparent として early Julio-Claudian dynasty の間に. Adopted 叔父の Emperor Tiberius によって, Germanicus earned 彼の cognomen を Rhine を越えた Germanic tribes に対する brilliant campaigns を通じて, avenging Teutoburg Forest の Battle での devastating defeat を、そして northern frontier での Roman prestige を restoring しました. His カリスマ的な leadership, 彼の soldiers への genuine concern, そして remarkable oratory skills は彼を legions と Roman people の両方に beloved にしました, while 彼の Agrippina the Elder との marriage は九人の子供を産み, including 将来の Emperor Caligula を. His Antioch での 33歳での mysterious death, Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso による poisoning の rumors の amid, empire を揺るがした political crisis を created し、彼を tragic hero として established し、その early demise は多くの人が Rome の greatest potential leader と考えていたものを奪いました.
test.en-deu: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), geboren als Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged als einer der most celebrated military commanders Roms und des empire's most promising heir apparent während der early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted von seinem Onkel Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned seinen cognomen durch brilliant campaigns gegen Germanic tribes beyond dem Rhine, avenging die devastating defeat bei der Battle of the Teutoburg Forest und restoring Roman prestige an der northern frontier. His charismatische leadership, genuine concern für seine soldiers, und remarkable oratory skills machten ihn beloved von beiden legions und dem Roman people, while seine marriage zu Agrippina the Elder neun Kinder produzierte, including den zukünftigen Emperor Caligula. His mysterious death in Antioch im Alter von 33 Jahren, amid rumors von poisoning durch Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, created eine political crisis die das empire erschütterte und established ihn als tragic hero dessen early demise Rom dessen beraubte, was viele als seinen greatest potential leader betrachteten.
test.en-spa: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), nacido como Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged como uno de los military commanders más celebrated de Roma y el heir apparent más promising del imperio durante la early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted por su tío Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned su cognomen a través de brilliant campaigns contra Germanic tribes beyond el Rhine, avenging la devastating defeat en la Battle of the Teutoburg Forest y restoring el prestige romano en la northern frontier. His liderazgo carismático, genuine concern por sus soldiers, y remarkable oratory skills lo hicieron beloved tanto por las legions como por el Roman people, while su marriage con Agrippina the Elder produjo nueve hijos, including el futuro Emperor Caligula. His mysterious death en Antioch a los 33 años, amid rumors de poisoning por el Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, created una political crisis que sacudió el empire y established lo como un tragic hero cuya early demise privó a Roma de lo que muchos consideraban su greatest potential leader.
test.en-fra: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), né Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged comme l'un des military commanders les plus celebrated de Rome et le heir apparent le plus promising de l'empire pendant la early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted par son oncle Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned son cognomen à travers des brilliant campaigns contre les Germanic tribes beyond le Rhine, avenging la devastating defeat à la Battle of the Teutoburg Forest et restoring le prestige romain sur la northern frontier. His leadership charismatique, genuine concern pour ses soldiers, et remarkable oratory skills le rendirent beloved des legions et du Roman people, while son marriage avec Agrippina the Elder produisit neuf enfants, including le futur Emperor Caligula. His mysterious death à Antioch à l'âge de 33 ans, amid des rumors de poisoning par le Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, created une political crisis qui ébranla l'empire et established lui comme un tragic hero dont la early demise priva Rome de ce que beaucoup considéraient comme son greatest potential leader.
test.en-ita: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), nato Nero Claudius Drusus, emerged come uno dei military commanders più celebrated di Roma e il heir apparent più promising dell'impero durante la early Julio-Claudian dynasty. Adopted dal suo zio Emperor Tiberius, Germanicus earned il suo cognomen attraverso brilliant campaigns contro le Germanic tribes beyond il Rhine, avenging la devastating defeat nella Battle of the Teutoburg Forest e restoring il prestige romano sulla northern frontier. His mysterious death ad Antioch all'età di 33 anni, amid rumors di poisoning dal Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, created una political crisis che scosse l'impero e established lui come un tragic hero la cui early demise privò Roma di quello che molti consideravano il suo greatest potential leader.
test.en-tha: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE) เกิดชื่อ Nero Claudius Drusus กลายเป็นหนึ่งในผู้บัญชาการทหารที่มีชื่อเสียงที่สุดของโรมและทายาทที่มีแนวโน้มดีที่สุดของจักรวรรดิในช่วงต้นของราชวงศ์จูลิโอ-คลอเดียน. รับเป็นบุตรบุญธรรมโดยจักรพรรดิไทบีเรียสลุงของเขา เจอร์มานิคัสได้รับฉายาผ่านการรณรงค์ที่ยอดเยี่ยมต่อต้านชนเผ่าเยอรมันิคข้ามแม่น้ำไรน์ แก้แค้นความพ่ายแพ้อันทำลายล้างในสงครามป่าทอยโทเบิร์ก และฟื้นฟูเกียรติยศของโรมันที่ชายแดนเหนือ. ภาวะผู้นำที่มีเสน่ห์ ความห่วงใยอย่างแท้จริงต่อทหารของเขา และทักษะการพูดที่โดดเด่นทำให้เขาเป็นที่รักของทั้งกองทัพและประชาชนโรมัน ในขณะที่การแต่งงานของเขากับอะกริปปินาผู้อาวุโสให้กำเนิดลูกเก้าคน รวมถึงจักรพรรดิคาลิกูลาในอนาคต. การเสียชีวิตอย่างลึกลับของเขาในแอนทิโอกในวัย 33 ปี ท่ามกลางข่าวลือเรื่องการวางยาพิษโดยผู้ว่าการซีเรียกเนอุส คัลพูร์นิอุส พิโซ สร้างวิกฤตการณ์ทางการเมืองที่สั่นสะเทือนจักรวรรดิและทำให้เขากลายเป็นวีรบุรุษที่น่าเศร้าซึ่งการตายก่อนวัยอันควรได้ปล้นโรมจากสิ่งที่หลายคนถือว่าเป็นผู้นำที่มีศักยภาพยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุด.
test.en-arb: جرمانيكوس يوليوس قيصر (15 ق.م - 19 م)، المولود باسم نيرو كلوديوس دروسوس، برز كواحد من أشهر القادة العسكريين في روما ووريث الإمبراطورية الأكثر واعدية خلال بداية السلالة اليوليو-كلوديانية. تبناه عمه الإمبراطور تيبيريوس، وكسب جرمانيكوس لقبه من خلال حملات رائعة ضد القبائل الجرمانية وراء نهر الراين، منتقماً للهزيمة المدمرة في معركة غابة تويتوبورغ ومستعيداً هيبة روما على الحدود الشمالية. قيادته الكاريزمية، واهتمامه الحقيقي بجنوده، ومهاراته الخطابية الرائعة جعلته محبوباً من قبل الفيالق والشعب الروماني، بينما أنتج زواجه من أغريبينا الكبرى تسعة أطفال، بما في ذلك الإمبراطور المستقبلي كاليجولا. وفاته الغامضة في أنطاكية في سن 33، وسط شائعات التسميم من قبل حاكم سوريا غنايوس كالبورنيوس بيسو، خلقت أزمة سياسية هزت الإمبراطورية وأسست له كبطل مأساوي كان موته المبكر قد حرم روما مما اعتبره الكثيرون أعظم قائد محتمل لها.
test.en-tur: Germanicus Julius Caesar (MÖ 15 - MS 19), Nero Claudius Drusus olarak doğdu ve Roma'nın en ünlü askeri komutanlarından biri ve imparatorluğun en umut verici varisi olarak erken Julio-Claudian hanedanlığı döneminde ortaya çıktı. Amcası İmparator Tiberius tarafından evlat edinilen Germanicus, Ren Nehri ötesindeki Germen kabilelerine karşı parlak seferler yaparak lakabını kazandı, Teutoburg Ormanı Savaşı'ndaki yıkıcı yenilginin intikamını aldı ve kuzey sınırında Roma prestijini restore etti. Karizmatik liderliği, askerlerine gerçek ilgisi ve olağanüstü hitabet becerileri onu hem lejyonlar hem de Roma halkı tarafından sevilen biri yaptı; Yaşlı Agrippina ile evliliği gelecekteki İmparator Caligula dahil dokuz çocuk doğurdu. Suriye valisi Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso tarafından zehirlenme söylentileri arasında 33 yaşında Antakya'daki gizemli ölümü, imparatorluğu sarsan siyasi bir kriz yarattı ve onu erken ölümü Roma'yı birçoklarının en büyük potansiyel lideri olarak gördüğü kişiden mahrum bırakan trajik bir kahraman olarak konumlandırdı.
test.en-kor: 게르마니쿠스 율리우스 카이사르 (기원전 15년 - 서기 19년)는 네로 클라우디우스 드루수스로 태어나 초기 율리오-클라우디우스 왕조 시대에 로마의 가장 유명한 군사 지휘관 중 한 명이자 제국의 가장 유망한 상속자로 부상했습니다. 삼촌인 티베리우스 황제의 양자가 된 게르마니쿠스는 라인강 너머 게르만 부족들에 대한 뛰어난 원정을 통해 자신의 별명을 얻었으며, 토이토부르크 숲 전투에서의 참혹한 패배에 복수하고 북부 국경에서 로마의 위신을 회복했습니다. 그의 카리스마적 리더십, 병사들에 대한 진정한 관심, 그리고 뛰어난 웅변술은 군단과 로마 시민들 모두에게 사랑받게 했으며, 대(大) 아그리피나와의 결혼으로 미래의 칼리굴라 황제를 포함한 9명의 자녀를 낳았습니다. 시리아 총독 그나이우스 칼푸르니우스 피소의 독살 의혹 속에서 33세의 나이로 안티오키아에서 신비롭게 죽은 그의 죽음은 제국을 뒤흔든 정치적 위기를 야기했고, 그를 일찍 죽어 많은 사람들이 로마의 가장 위대한 잠재적 지도자로 여겼던 인물을 빼앗아간 비극적 영웅으로 만들었습니다.
test.en-hin: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), Nero Claudius Drusus के रूप में born, emerged रोम के सबसे celebrated military commanders में से एक के रूप में और empire के सबसे promising heir apparent के रूप में early Julio-Claudian dynasty के दौरान। Adopted अपने uncle Emperor Tiberius द्वारा, Germanicus earned अपना cognomen Rhine के पार Germanic tribes के against brilliant campaigns के through, avenging Battle of the Teutoburg Forest में devastating defeat को और northern frontier पर Roman prestige को restoring करते हुए। His charismatic leadership, अपने soldiers के लिए genuine concern, और remarkable oratory skills ने उसे legions और Roman people दोनों के द्वारा beloved बनाया, while उसकी Agrippina the Elder से marriage ने नौ children produce किए, including भविष्य के Emperor Caligula को। His mysterious death Antioch में 33 की age में, Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso द्वारा poisoning के rumors के amid, created एक political crisis जिसने empire को हिला दिया और established उसे एक tragic hero के रूप में जिसकी early demise ने Rome को उससे rob किया जिसे many लोग उसका greatest potential leader मानते थे।
test.en-ben: জার্মানিকাস জুলিয়াস সিজার (১৫ খ্রিস্টপূর্ব - ১৯ খ্রিস্টাব্দ), নেরো ক্লডিয়াস ড্রুসাস নামে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন, প্রাথমিক জুলিও-ক্লডিয়ান রাজবংশের সময় রোমের সবচেয়ে প্রশংসিত সামরিক কমান্ডারদের একজন এবং সাম্রাজ্যের সবচেয়ে প্রতিশ্রুতিশীল উত্তরাধিকারী হিসেবে আবির্ভূত হন। তার চাচা সম্রাট তিবেরিয়াস কর্তৃক দত্তক নেওয়া, জার্মানিকাস রাইন নদীর ওপারে জার্মানিক উপজাতিদের বিরুদ্ধে উজ্জ্বল অভিযানের মাধ্যমে তার উপাধি অর্জন করেন, টয়োটোবার্গ বনের যুদ্ধে ধ্বংসাত্মক পরাজয়ের প্রতিশোধ নিয়ে এবং উত্তর সীমান্তে রোমান মর্যাদা পুনরুদ্ধার করে। তার ক্যারিশম্যাটিক নেতৃত্ব, সৈন্যদের প্রতি প্রকৃত যত্ন এবং অসাধারণ বাগ্মিতা দক্ষতা তাকে সৈন্যদল এবং রোমান জনগণ উভয়ের কাছে প্রিয় করে তুলেছিল, যখন বয়স্ক আগ্রিপ্পিনার সাথে তার বিবাহ ভবিষ্যৎ সম্রাট ক্যালিগুলা সহ নয়টি সন্তানের জন্ম দেয়। সিরিয়ান গভর্নর গনেয়াস ক্যালপার্নিয়াস পিসোর বিষপ্রয়োগের গুজবের মধ্যে ৩৩ বছর বয়সে অ্যান্টিওকে তার রহস্যজনক মৃত্যু একটি রাজনৈতিক সংকট সৃষ্টি করে যা সাম্রাজ্যকে কাঁপিয়ে দেয় এবং তাকে একজন দুঃখজনক বীর হিসেবে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করে যার অকাল মৃত্যু রোমকে এমন কিছু থেকে বঞ্চিত করেছিল যা অনেকে তার সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ সম্ভাব্য নেতা বলে মনে করত।
test.en-tel: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), Nero Claudius Drusus గా born అయ్యి, early Julio-Claudian dynasty సమయంలో రోమ్ యొక్క అత్యంత celebrated military commanders లో ఒకరిగా మరియు empire యొక్క అత్యంత promising heir apparent గా emerged అయ్యాడు. His uncle Emperor Tiberius చేత adopted అయిన, Germanicus Rhine దాటి Germanic tribes పై brilliant campaigns ద్వారా తన cognomen ను earned చేసుకున్నాడు, Battle of the Teutoburg Forest లో devastating defeat కు avenging చేస్తూ మరియు northern frontier లో Roman prestige ను restoring చేస్తూ. His charismatic leadership, తన soldiers పట్ల genuine concern, మరియు remarkable oratory skills అతన్ని legions మరియు Roman people రెండింటికీ beloved చేశాయి, while Agrippina the Elder తో అతని marriage భవిష్యత్ Emperor Caligula తో సహా తొమ్మిది children ను produced చేసింది. Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso చేత poisoning యొక్క rumors మధ్య Antioch లో 33 age లో అతని mysterious death, empire ను shock చేసిన political crisis ను created చేసింది మరియు అతన్ని tragic hero గా established చేసింది, దీని early demise చాలా మంది Rome యొక్క greatest potential leader గా consider చేసిన వ్యక్తి నుండి Rome ను rob చేసింది.
test.en-swa: Germanicus Julius Caesar (15 BCE - 19 CE), aliyezaliwa kama Nero Claudius Drusus, aliibuka kama mmoja wa majemedari wa kijeshi waliostahimiliwa zaidi wa Roma na mrithi mwenye matumaini makubwa zaidi wa ufalme wakati wa mwanzo wa nasaba ya Julio-Claudian. Alipokelewa na mjomba wake Mfalme Tiberius, Germanicus alipata jina lake kupitia mapigano mabichi dhidi ya makabila ya Kijerumani ngʼambo ya mto Rhine, akilipiza kisasi cha kushindwa kwa uharibifu katika Vita ya Msitu wa Teutoburg na kurejesha heshima ya Kirumi katika mpaka wa kaskazini. Uongozi wake wa mvuto, mawazo ya kweli kwa askari wake, na ujuzi wake wa hotuba ulifanya apendewe na majeshi na watu wa Roma, wakati ndoa yake na Agrippina Mkuu ilizaa watoto tisa, ikiwa ni pamoja na Mfalme wa baadaye Caligula. Kifo chake cha fumbo huko Antioch akiwa na umri wa miaka 33, katikati ya vishindo vya sumu na gavana wa Syria Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, kiliumba machafuko ya kisiasa ambayo yalitikisa ufalme na kumthibitisha kama shujaa wa huzuni ambaye kifo chake cha mapema kilimnyangʼanya Roma kile ambacho wengi walikiona kuwa kiongozi wake mkuu mwenye uwezo.
test.fa: ژرمانیکوس یولیوس سزار (۱۵ پیش از میلاد - ۱۹ میلادی)، که با نام نرو کلودیوس دروسوس متولد شد، به عنوان یکی از مشهورترین فرماندهان نظامی روم و امیدوارترین وارث ظاهری امپراتوری در طول سلسله اولیه یولیو-کلودیان ظهور کرد. ژرمانیکوس که توسط عمویش امپراتور تیبریوس فرزندخوانده شد، لقب خود را از طریق لشکرکشی‌های درخشان علیه قبایل ژرمن در آن سوی رین به دست آورد، انتقام شکست ویرانگر در نبرد جنگل توتوبورگ را گرفت و اعتبار روم را در مرز شمالی احیا کرد. رهبری کاریزماتیک، توجه صمیمانه به سربازانش، و مهارت‌های فوق‌العاده خطابه او را نزد هم لژیون‌ها و هم مردم روم محبوب ساخت، در حالی که ازدواج او با آگریپینا بزرگ نه فرزند به دنیا آورد، از جمله امپراتور آینده کالیگولا. مرگ مرموز او در آنتاکیه در سن ۳۳ سالگی، در میان شایعات مسمومیت توسط فرماندار سوریه گنائوس کالپورنیوس پیسو، بحران سیاسی ایجاد کرد که امپراتوری را لرزاند و او را به عنوان قهرمان تراژیک تثبیت کرد که مرگ زودهنگام او روم را از آنچه بسیاری بزرگترین رهبر بالقوه آن می‌دانستند محروم کرد.
test.tur: Nero Claudius Drusus olarak doğan Germanicus Julius Caesar (MÖ 15 - MS 19), erken Julio-Claudian hanedanlığı döneminde Roma'nın en ünlü askeri komutanlarından ve imparatorluğun en umut verici varisi olarak ortaya çıkmıştır. Amcası İmparator Tiberius tarafından evlatlık alınan Germanicus, Ren'in ötesindeki Germen kabilelerine karşı parlak seferler düzenleyerek, Teutoburg Ormanı Savaşı'ndaki yıkıcı yenilginin intikamını alarak ve kuzey sınırında Roma prestijini restore ederek soyadını kazanmıştır. Karizmatik liderliği, askerlerine gerçek ilgisi ve olağanüstü hatiplik becerileri onu hem lejyonlar hem de Roma halkı tarafından sevilen biri yaparken, Yaşlı Agrippina ile evliliği gelecekteki İmparator Caligula dahil dokuz çocuk doğurmuştur. 33 yaşında Antakya'da Suriye valisi Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso tarafından zehirlenme söylentileri arasında gizemli ölümü, imparatorluğu sarsan siyasi bir kriz yaratmış ve onu erken ölümü Roma'yı birçoklarının en büyük potansiyel lideri olarak gördüğü kişiden yoksun bırakan trajik bir kahraman olarak konumlandırmıştır.
test.ita: Germanico Giulio Cesare (15 a.C. - 19 d.C.), nato Nerone Claudio Druso, emerse come uno dei comandanti militari più celebrati di Roma e l'erede apparente più promettente dell'impero durante la prima dinastia giulio-claudia. Adottato da suo zio l'Imperatore Tiberio, Germanico guadagnò il suo cognome attraverso brillanti campagne contro le tribù germaniche oltre il Reno, vendicando la devastante sconfitta nella Battaglia della Foresta di Teutoburgo e ripristinando il prestigio romano sulla frontiera settentrionale. La sua leadership carismatica, la genuina preoccupazione per i suoi soldati e le notevoli abilità oratorie lo resero amato sia dalle legioni che dal popolo romano, mentre il suo matrimonio con Agrippina Maggiore produsse nove figli, incluso il futuro Imperatore Caligola. La sua morte misteriosa ad Antiochia all'età di 33 anni, tra voci di avvelenamento da parte del governatore siriano Gneo Calpurnio Pisone, creò una crisi politica che scosse l'impero e lo stabilì come un eroe tragico la cui prematura scomparsa privò Roma di quello che molti consideravano il suo più grande leader potenziale.
test.zho: 日耳曼尼库斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒（公元前15年-公元19年），原名尼禄·克劳狄乌斯·德鲁苏斯，在早期朱里亚-克劳狄王朝时期成为罗马最著名的军事指挥官之一和帝国最有前途的继承人。被其叔父皇帝提比略收养后，日耳曼尼库斯通过对莱茵河以外日耳曼部落的辉煌战役赢得了其称号，为条顿堡森林战役的毁灭性失败复仇，并恢复了罗马在北部边境的威望。他富有魅力的领导力、对士兵的真诚关怀和卓越的演说技巧使他深受军团和罗马人民的爱戴，而他与老阿格里皮娜的婚姻生育了九个孩子，包括未来的皇帝卡利古拉。他33岁时在安条克的神秘死亡，伴随着被叙利亚总督格奈乌斯·卡尔普尔尼乌斯·皮索毒杀的传言，引发了震撼帝国的政治危机，并使他成为一个悲剧英雄，其早逝使罗马失去了许多人认为的最伟大的潜在领袖。

validation.explanation: Indian independence leader who pioneered nonviolent resistance and became a global symbol of peace
validation.en: Mahatma Gandhi (1869-1948), born Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi in Porbandar, Gujarat, transformed from a shy lawyer into history's most influential advocate of nonviolent resistance and became the father of Indian independence. After experiencing racial discrimination in South Africa, Gandhi developed his philosophy of satyagraha (truth-force), combining civil disobedience with moral authority to challenge injustice without violence. Returning to India in 1915, he led the independence movement through iconic campaigns like the Salt March of 1930, where he walked 240 miles to the Arabian Sea to make salt in defiance of British colonial laws. His ascetic lifestyle, spinning wheel symbolism, and unwavering commitment to ahimsa (nonviolence) inspired millions of Indians and influenced civil rights leaders worldwide, including Martin Luther King Jr., making him a timeless symbol of peaceful resistance whose assassination in 1948 shocked the world and cemented his legacy as the Mahatma (great soul).

Returning в India в 1915, он led independence movement через iconic campaigns like Salt March 1930 года, где он walked 240 miles к Arabian Sea чтобы make salt в defiance британских colonial laws. His аскетический lifestyle, прялка symbolism, и unwavering commitment к ахимсе (nonviolence) inspired миллионы Indians и influenced civil rights leaders worldwide, including Martin Luther King Jr., making его timeless symbol мирного resistance чьё assassination в 1948 shocked мир и cemented его legacy как Mahatma (great soul).

After experiencing 在南非的种族歧视, Gandhi developed 他的真理力量哲学 (satyagraha), combining civil disobedience 与道德权威来挑战不公正而不使用暴力. Returning 到印度在1915年, 他通过标志性运动领导独立运动 like 1930年的食盐长征, 在那里他步行240英里到阿拉伯海制盐 in defiance 英国殖民法律. His 苦行的生活方式, 纺车象征意义, 和对非暴力坚定不移的承诺 inspired 数百万印度人 and influenced 全世界的民权领袖, including Martin Luther King Jr., making 他成为和平抵抗的永恒象征，其1948年的暗杀震惊了世界 and cemented 他作为圣雄(伟大灵魂)的遗产.

His mtindo wa kimaisha wa kizuizi, spinning wheel symbolism, na unwavering commitment kwa ahimsa (kutokana na vurugu) ilihamasisha mamilioni ya Indians na kuathiri viongozi wa haki za kiraia worldwide, including Martin Luther King Jr., na kumfanya alama ya timeless ya upinzani wa amani ambaye assassination yake mnamo 1948 ilishangaza dunia na kuimarisha urithi wake kama Mahatma (roho kuu).
validation.fa: مهاتما گاندی (۱۸۶۹-۱۹۴۸)، که با نام موهانداس کارامچند گاندی در پوربندر، گجرات متولد شد، از یک وکیل خجالتی به تأثیرگذارترین مدافع مقاومت غیرخشونت‌آمیز تاریخ تبدیل شد و به پدر استقلال هند بدل شد. پس از تجربه تبعیض نژادی در آفریقای جنوبی، گاندی فلسفه ستیاگرها (نیروی حقیقت) را توسعه داد که نافرمانی مدنی را با اقتدار اخلاقی ترکیب کرد تا بی‌عدالتی را بدون خشونت به چالش بکشد. او که در سال ۱۹۱۵ به هند بازگشت، جنبش استقلال را از طریق کمپین‌های نمادین مانند راهپیمایی نمک در سال ۱۹۳۰ رهبری کرد، جایی که ۲۴۰ مایل تا دریای عرب پیاده روی کرد تا در نافرمانی از قوانین استعماری بریتانیا نمک تولید کند. سبک زندگی زاهدانه، نمادگرایی چرخ نخ‌ریسی، و تعهد تزلزل‌ناپذیر به اهیمسا (غیرخشونت) میلیون‌ها هندی را الهام بخشید و بر رهبران حقوق مدنی در سراسر جهان از جمله مارتین لوتر کینگ جونیور تأثیر گذاشت و او را به نمادی جاودانه از مقاومت مسالمت‌آمیز تبدیل کرد که ترور او در سال ۱۹۴۸ جهان را شوکه کرد و میراث او را به عنوان مهاتما (روح بزرگ) تثبیت کرد.
validation.tur: Gujarat'ın Porbandar kentinde Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi olarak doğan Mahatma Gandhi (1869-1948), utangaç bir avukattan tarihin en etkili şiddet karşıtı direniş savunucusuna dönüşerek Hindistan bağımsızlığının babası olmuştur. Güney Afrika'da ırksal ayrımcılık yaşadıktan sonra Gandhi, sivil itaatsizliği ahlaki otorite ile birleştirerek adaletsizliğe şiddet kullanmadan meydan okumak için satyagraha (hakikat-güç) felsefesini geliştirmiştir. 1915'te Hindistan'a dönen Gandhi, İngiliz sömürge yasalarına meydan okuyarak tuz yapmak üzere Arap Denizi'ne 240 mil yürüdüğü 1930 Tuz Yürüyüşü gibi ikonik kampanyalarla bağımsızlık hareketini yönetmiştir. Çileci yaşam tarzı, çıkrık sembolizmi ve ahimsa'ya (şiddet kullanmama) sarsılmaz bağlılığı milyonlarca Hintliyi ilham vermiş ve Martin Luther King Jr. dahil dünya çapındaki sivil haklar liderlerini etkilemiş, onu barışçıl direnişin zamansız sembolü haline getirmiş, 1948'deki suikasti dünyayı şok etmiş ve Mahatma (büyük ruh) olarak mirasını pekiştirmiştir.
validation.ita: Mahatma Gandhi (1869-1948), nato Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi a Porbandar, Gujarat, si trasformò da un avvocato timido nel più influente sostenitore della resistenza nonviolenta della storia e divenne il padre dell'indipendenza indiana. Dopo aver sperimentato la discriminazione razziale in Sud Africa, Gandhi sviluppò la sua filosofia di satyagraha (forza-verità), combinando la disobbedienza civile con l'autorità morale per sfidare l'ingiustizia senza violenza. Tornato in India nel 1915, guidò il movimento per l'indipendenza attraverso campagne iconiche come la Marcia del Sale del 1930, dove camminò per 240 miglia fino al Mar Arabico per produrre sale sfidando le leggi coloniali britanniche. Il suo stile di vita ascetico, il simbolismo della ruota del filatoio e l'impegno incrollabile verso l'ahimsa (nonviolenza) ispirarono milioni di indiani e influenzarono i leader dei diritti civili in tutto il mondo, incluso Martin Luther King Jr., rendendolo un simbolo senza tempo di resistenza pacifica il cui assassinio nel 1948 scioccò il mondo e cementò la sua eredità come Mahatma (grande anima).
validation.zho: 圣雄甘地（1869-1948），出生时名为莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地，出生于古吉拉特邦波尔班达尔，从一个害羞的律师转变为历史上最有影响力的非暴力抵抗倡导者，成为印度独立之父。在南非经历种族歧视后，甘地发展了他的真理力量（satyagraha）哲学，将公民不服从与道德权威相结合，以非暴力方式挑战不公正。1915年返回印度后，他通过标志性的运动领导独立运动，如1930年的食盐长征，他步行240英里到阿拉伯海制盐，违抗英国殖民法律。他的苦行生活方式、纺车象征主义和对非暴力（ahimsa）的坚定承诺激励了数百万印度人，并影响了包括马丁·路德·金在内的世界各地的民权领袖，使他成为和平抵抗的永恒象征，1948年的暗杀震惊了世界，巩固了他作为圣雄（伟大灵魂）的遗产。

validation.explanation: Iconic mausoleum in India, considered one of the world's most beautiful architectural masterpieces
validation.en: The Taj Mahal, standing majestically on the banks of the Yamuna River in Agra, represents the pinnacle of Mughal architecture and serves as history's most enduring monument to eternal love. Built between 1632 and 1653 by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died during childbirth, this ivory-white marble masterpiece combines Islamic, Persian, and Indian architectural elements in perfect harmony. The central dome, flanked by four minarets and adorned with intricate inlay work of semi-precious stones, changes color throughout the day from pinkish hues at dawn to golden tones at sunset, creating an ethereal beauty that has captivated millions of visitors. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the Taj Mahal continues to symbolize India's rich cultural heritage while facing modern challenges from pollution and tourism that threaten its pristine marble surfaces.

The central dome, imezungukwa na minarets nne na imepambwa na intricate inlay work ya mawe ya thamani kidogo, hubadilisha rangi mchana kutwa kutoka kwa pinkish hues alfajiri hadi golden tones jioni, ikiunda ethereal beauty ambayo imevutia millions ya wageni. Recognized kama UNESCO World Heritage Site na moja ya New Seven Wonders za dunia, Taj Mahal inaendelea kuashiria utamaduni mkuu wa India huku ikikabiliana na changamoto za kisasa za uchafuzi na utalii ambazo zinahatarisha nyuso zake za marmar safi.
validation.fa: تاج محل، که با عظمت در کنار رودخانه یامونا در آگرا ایستاده است، نماینده اوج معماری مغولی است و به عنوان ماندگارترین بنای یادبود عشق ابدی در تاریخ عمل می‌کند. این شاهکار مرمری عاج‌سفید که بین سال‌های ۱۶۳۲ تا ۱۶۵۳ توسط امپراتور شاه جهان به عنوان مقبره برای همسر محبوبش ممتاز محل که در هنگام زایمان درگذشت، ساخته شد، عناصر معماری اسلامی، فارسی و هندی را در هماهنگی کامل ترکیب می‌کند. گنبد مرکزی، که توسط چهار مناره احاطه شده و با کار منبت‌کاری پیچیده از سنگ‌های نیمه‌قیمتی تزیین شده است، طول روز رنگ عوض می‌کند، از رنگ‌های صورتی در سپیده دم تا رنگ‌های طلایی در غروب، و زیبایی اثیری ایجاد می‌کند که میلیون‌ها بازدیدکننده را مجذوب کرده است. تاج محل که به عنوان میراث جهانی یونسکو و یکی از هفت عجایب جدید جهان شناخته می‌شود، همچنان نماد میراث فرهنگی غنی هند است، در حالی که با چالش‌های مدرن آلودگی و گردشگری روبروست که سطوح مرمری بکر آن را تهدید می‌کند.
validation.tur: Agra'da Yamuna Nehri kıyılarında görkemle duran Tac Mahal, Moğol mimarisinin zirvesini temsil eder ve tarihin sonsuz aşka dair en kalıcı anıtı olarak hizmet eder. 1632-1653 yılları arasında İmparator Şah Cihan tarafından doğum sırasında ölen sevgili eşi Mümtaz Mahal için türbe olarak inşa edilen bu fildişi beyazı mermer başyapıt, İslami, Fars ve Hint mimari unsurlarını mükemmel uyum içinde birleştirir. Dört minare ile çevrelenen ve yarı değerli taşlardan oluşan karmaşık kakma işçiliği ile süslenen merkezi kubbe, şafakta pembe tonlardan gün batımında altın tonlara kadar gün boyunca renk değiştirerek milyonlarca ziyaretçiyi büyüleyen ruhani bir güzellik yaratır. UNESCO Dünya Mirası Alanı ve Dünyanın Yeni Yedi Harikasından biri olarak tanınan Tac Mahal, bozulmamış mermer yüzeylerini tehdit eden kirlilik ve turizm gibi modern zorluklarla karşı karşıya kalırken Hindistan'ın zengin kültürel mirasını sembolize etmeye devam etmektedir.
validation.ita: Il Taj Mahal, che si erge maestosamente sulle rive del fiume Yamuna ad Agra, rappresenta l'apice dell'architettura Mughal e serve come il monumento più duraturo della storia all'amore eterno. Costruito tra il 1632 e il 1653 dall'Imperatore Shah Jahan come mausoleo per la sua amata moglie Mumtaz Mahal, morta durante il parto, questo capolavoro di marmo bianco avorio combina elementi architettonici islamici, persiani e indiani in perfetta armonia. La cupola centrale, fiancheggiata da quattro minareti e adornata con intricati lavori di intarsio di pietre semipreziose, cambia colore durante il giorno dalle tonalità rosate all'alba ai toni dorati al tramonto, creando una bellezza eterea che ha affascinato milioni di visitatori. Riconosciuto come Sito Patrimonio dell'Umanità UNESCO e una delle Nuove Sette Meraviglie del Mondo, il Taj Mahal continua a simboleggiare il ricco patrimonio culturale dell'India mentre affronta sfide moderne dall'inquinamento e dal turismo che minacciano le sue superfici di marmo incontaminate.
validation.zho: 泰姬陵雄伟地矗立在阿格拉亚穆纳河畔，代表着莫卧儿建筑的巅峰，是历史上最持久的永恒爱情纪念碑。这座象牙白大理石杰作由皇帝沙贾汗在1632年至1653年间建造，作为他在分娩时去世的爱妻蒙泰姬·玛哈尔的陵墓，完美和谐地结合了伊斯兰、波斯和印度建筑元素。中央圆顶两侧是四座尖塔，装饰着复杂的半宝石镶嵌工艺，从黎明的粉红色调到日落时的金色调，全天变换着颜色，创造出迷人的空灵之美，吸引了数百万游客。泰姬陵被联合国教科文组织认定为世界遗产，也是世界新七大奇迹之一，它继续象征着印度丰富的文化遗产，同时面临着来自污染和旅游业的现代挑战，威胁着其原始的大理石表面。

validation.explanation: Strategic body of water in Western Asia, vital for global oil transport and regional geopolitics
validation.en: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990 kilometers between the Arabian Peninsula and Iran, serves as one of the world's most strategically important waterways and the epicenter of global energy trade. This shallow marginal sea, connected to the Arabian Sea through the narrow Strait of Hormuz, borders eight nations including Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, and Oman, collectively controlling nearly 40% of the world's proven oil reserves. The Gulf's warm, saline waters support diverse marine ecosystems including coral reefs, seagrass beds, and critical habitats for endangered species like the hawksbill turtle and dugong, while its coastlines have witnessed the rise of ancient civilizations and modern petrochemical megacities. Despite facing environmental challenges from oil spills, industrial pollution, and climate change, the Persian Gulf remains a vital artery for international commerce, with over 17 million barrels of oil passing through the Strait of Hormuz daily, making it arguably the world's most important energy chokepoint.

Despite facing environmental challenges от oil spills, industrial pollution, и climate change, Persian Gulf remains жизненно важной artery для international commerce, с более 17 million barrels нефти passing через Strait of Hormuz daily, making его arguably мира самым important energy chokepoint.

validation.en-tha: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990กิโลเมตร between คาบสมุทรอาหรับและอิหร่าน, serves เป็นหนึ่งในเส้นทางน้ำที่สำคัญทางยุทธศาสตร์ที่สุดของโลก และ epicenter ของการค้าพลังงานโลก. This shallow marginal sea, connected กับทะเลอาหรับผ่านช่องแคบฮอร์มุซที่แคบ, borders แปดประเทศ including อิหร่าน อิรัก คูเวต ซาอุดีอาระเบีย บาห์เรน กาตาร์ สหรัฐอาหรับเอมิเรตส์ และโอมาน, collectively controlling เกือบ40%ของปิโตรเลียมสำรองที่พิสูจน์แล้วของโลก. The Gulf's น้ำอุ่นและเค็ม support ระบบนิเวศทางทะเลที่หลากหลาย including แนวปะการัง ทุ่งหญ้าทะเล และ critical habitats สำหรับสัตว์ที่ใกล้สูญพันธุ์เช่นเต่าตนุและพะยูน, while ชายฝั่งของมัน witnessed การเกิดขึ้นของอารยธรรมโบราณและเมืองใหญ่อุตสาหกรรมปิโตรเคมีสมัยใหม่. Despite facing ความท้าทายด้านสิ่งแวดล้อมจากการรั่วไหลของน้ำมัน มลพิษทางอุตสาหกรรม และการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ, Persian Gulf remains เส้นเลือดใหญ่สำคัญสำหรับการค้าระหว่างประเทศ โดยมีน้ำมันกว่า17ล้านบาร์เรล passing through ช่องแคบฮอร์มุซทุกวัน making มันเป็นจุดคอขวดพลังงานที่สำคัญที่สุดของโลก.
validation.en-arb: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990 كيلومتراً between شبه الجزيرة العربية وإيران، serves كواحد من أهم الممرات المائية strategically في العالم و epicenter التجارة العالمية للطاقة. This البحر الهامشي الضحل، connected بالبحر العربي عبر مضيق هرمز الضيق، borders ثماني دول including إيران والعراق والكويت والسعودية والبحرين وقطر والإمارات وعُمان، collectively controlling ما يقرب من 40% من احتياطيات النفط المؤكدة في العالم. The Gulf's المياه الدافئة والمالحة support النظم البيئية البحرية المتنوعة including الشعاب المرجانية وأحراش الأعشاب البحرية والموائل الحرجة للأنواع المهددة بالانقراض مثل السلاحف منقار الصقر وخراف البحر، while سواحله witnessed نهوض الحضارات القديمة والمدن الكبرى البتروكيماوية الحديثة. Despite facing التحديات البيئية من انسكابات النفط والتلوث الصناعي وتغير المناخ، Persian Gulf remains شرياناً حيوياً للتجارة الدولية، مع أكثر من 17 مليون برميل من النفط passing through مضيق هرمز يومياً، making إياه arguably أهم نقطة اختناق للطاقة في العالم.
validation.en-tur: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990 kilometre Arap Yarımadası ile İran arasında, serves dünyanın en strategically important su yollarından biri ve global enerji ticaretinin epicenter'ı olarak. This sığ kenar denizi, dar Hürmüz Boğazı üzerinden Arap Denizi'ne connected, İran, Irak, Kuveyt, Suudi Arabistan, Bahreyn, Katar, BAE ve Umman including sekiz ülkeyi borders ediyor, collectively dünyanın kanıtlanmış petrol rezervlerinin yaklaşık %40'ını controlling. The Gulf'ın sıcak, tuzlu suları mercan resifleri, deniz çayırları ve şahin gagalı kaplumbağa ve dugong gibi endangered species için critical habitats including çeşitli marine ecosystems'ı support ediyor, while kıyıları ancient civilizations ve modern petrochemical megacities'in yükselişini witnessed etti. Despite petrol sızıntıları, endüstriyel kirlilik ve iklim değişikliğinden environmental challenges'la facing olmasına rağmen, Persian Gulf international commerce için vital bir arter olmaya remains ediyor, günlük 17 milyon varilden fazla petrol Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan passing ederek, onu arguably dünyanın en önemli enerji chokepoint'i making ediyor.
validation.en-kor: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990킬로미터 between 아라비아 반도와 이란, serves 세계에서 가장 strategically important한 수로 중 하나로 and global energy trade의 epicenter로. The Gulf의 따뜻하고 염분이 많은 waters는 coral reefs, seagrass beds, 그리고 hawksbill turtle과 dugong 같은 endangered species를 위한 critical habitats를 including한 diverse marine ecosystems를 support합니다, while 그 coastlines는 ancient civilizations와 modern petrochemical megacities의 rise를 witnessed했습니다. Despite oil spills, industrial pollution, 그리고 climate change로부터의 environmental challenges에 facing함에도 불구하고, Persian Gulf는 international commerce를 위한 vital artery로 remains하며, 매일 17 million barrels 이상의 석유가 Strait of Hormuz를 passing하여, 그것을 arguably 세계에서 가장 important한 energy chokepoint로 making합니다.
validation.en-hin: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately 990 किलोमीटर between Arabian Peninsula और Iran, serves दुनिया के सबसे strategically important waterways में से एक के रूप में और global energy trade का epicenter। This shallow marginal sea, connected Arabian Sea से narrow Strait of Hormuz के through, borders आठ nations including Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, और Oman, collectively controlling दुनिया के proven oil reserves का लगभग 40%। The Gulf के गर्म, नमकीन waters support diverse marine ecosystems including coral reefs, seagrass beds, और endangered species जैसे hawksbill turtle और dugong के लिए critical habitats, while इसके coastlines ने ancient civilizations और modern petrochemical megacities के rise को witnessed किया है। Despite oil spills, industrial pollution, और climate change से environmental challenges का facing करने के बावजूद, Persian Gulf remains international commerce के लिए एक vital artery, daily 17 million barrels से अधिक oil के साथ Strait of Hormuz से passing होते हुए, making इसे arguably दुनिया का सबसे important energy chokepoint।

This shallow marginal sea, connected అరేబియా సముద్రంతో narrow Strait of Hormuz ద్వారా, borders ఎనిమిది nations including ఇరాన్, ఇరాక్, కువైట్, సౌదీ అరేబియా, బహ్రయిన్, కతర్, UAE, మరియు ఒమన్, collectively controlling ప్రపంచ proven oil reserves లో దాదాపు 40%. The Gulf యొక్క వెచ్చని, ఉప్పునీటి waters support diverse marine ecosystems including coral reefs, seagrass beds, మరియు endangered species అయిన hawksbill turtle మరియు dugong కు critical habitats, while దాని coastlines ancient civilizations మరియు modern petrochemical megacities యొక్క rise ను witnessed చేశాయి. Despite oil spills, industrial pollution, మరియు climate change నుండి environmental challenges ను facing చేస్తున్నప్పటికీ, Persian Gulf remains international commerce కొరకు vital artery గా, daily 17 million barrels కంటే ఎక్కువ oil Strait of Hormuz గుండా passing అవుతూ, making దీనిని arguably ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత important energy chokepoint గా.
validation.en-swa: The Persian Gulf, stretching approximately kilomita 990 kati ya Peninsula ya Kiarabu na Iran, serves kama mojawapo ya njia za maji muhimu zaidi strategically duniani na kitovu cha biashara ya nishati duniani. This bahari ya pembeni ya kina kifupi, iliyounganishwa na Bahari ya Kiarabu kupitia njia nyembamba ya Hormuz, inazunguka mataifa nane ikiwa ni pamoja na Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, na Oman, pamoja inayodhibiti karibu asilimia 40 ya akiba za mafuta zilizothibitishwa duniani. Maji ya Gulf yaliyo joto na chumvi yanaunga mkono mazingira mbalimbali ya baharini ikiwa ni pamoja na miamba ya marijani, bustani za nyasi za baharini, na makazi muhimu ya spishi hatarini kama kobe wa mdomo wa koroma na dugong, wakati fukizo zake zimeshuhudia kuongezeka kwa tamaduni za kale na miji mikuu ya kisasa ya petrochemical. Licha ya kukabiliana na changamoto za mazingira kutokana na kumwagika kwa mafuta, uchafuzi wa viwandani, na mabadiliko ya tabianchi, Persian Gulf inabaki kuwa mchoro muhimu wa biashara ya kimataifa, na mapipa zaidi ya milioni 17 ya mafuta yanapita kupitia Njia ya Hormuz kila siku, na kuifanya kuwa kizibo cha nishati muhimu zaidi duniani.
validation.fa: خلیج فارس، که تقریباً ۹۹۰ کیلومتر بین شبه‌جزیره عربستان و ایران کشیده شده است، به عنوان یکی از استراتژیک‌ترین آبراه‌های جهان و مرکز تجارت انرژی جهانی عمل می‌کند. این دریای حاشیه‌ای کم‌عمق، که از طریق تنگه هرمز باریک به دریای عرب متصل می‌شود، با هشت کشور از جمله ایران، عراق، کویت، عربستان سعودی، بحرین، قطر، امارات متحده عربی و عمان هم مرز است که در مجموع نزدیک به ۴۰ درصد از ذخایر اثبات شده نفت جهان را کنترل می‌کنند. آب‌های گرم و شور خلیج از اکوسیستم‌های دریایی متنوعی شامل صخره‌های مرجانی، بسترهای علف دریایی و زیستگاه‌های حیاتی برای گونه‌های در معرض خطر مانند لاک‌پشت عقابی و گاو دریایی حمایت می‌کند، در حالی که سواحل آن شاهد ظهور تمدن‌های باستانی و کلان‌شهرهای مدرن پتروشیمی بوده است. علی‌رغم رویارویی با چالش‌های زیست‌محیطی از نشت نفت، آلودگی صنعتی و تغییرات آب و هوایی، خلیج فارس همچنان شریان حیاتی برای تجارت بین‌المللی باقی می‌ماند، با بیش از ۱۷ میلیون بشکه نفت که روزانه از تنگه هرمز عبور می‌کند، که آن را به بحث‌برانگیزترین گلوگاه انرژی جهان تبدیل می‌کند.
validation.tur: Arap Yarımadası ile İran arasında yaklaşık 990 kilometre uzanan Basra Körfezi, dünyanın stratejik açıdan en önemli su yollarından biri ve küresel enerji ticaretinin merkezi olarak hizmet etmektedir. Dar Hürmüz Boğazı aracılığıyla Arap Denizi'ne bağlanan bu sığ kenar deniz, İran, Irak, Kuveyt, Suudi Arabistan, Bahreyn, Katar, Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri ve Umman dahil sekiz ülkeye sınır komşusu olup, toplu olarak dünyanın kanıtlanmış petrol rezervlerinin neredeyse %40'ını kontrol etmektedir. Körfez'in sıcak, tuzlu suları mercan resifleri, deniz çayırları ve şahin gagalı kaplumbağa ve dugong gibi nesli tehlike altındaki türlerin kritik yaşam alanları dahil çeşitli deniz ekosistemlerini desteklerken, kıyıları antik medeniyetlerin ve modern petrokimya mega şehirlerinin yükselişine tanık olmuştur. Petrol sızıntıları, endüstriyel kirlilik ve iklim değişikliğinden kaynaklanan çevresel zorluklarla karşı karşıya olmasına rağmen, Basra Körfezi uluslararası ticaret için hayati bir arter olmaya devam etmekte, günde 17 milyon varilden fazla petrol Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan geçerek onu tartışmasız dünyanın en önemli enerji darboğazı yapmaktadır.
validation.ita: Il Golfo Persico, che si estende per circa 990 chilometri tra la Penisola Arabica e l'Iran, serve come una delle vie navigabili strategicamente più importanti del mondo e l'epicentro del commercio energetico globale. Questo mare marginale poco profondo, collegato al Mar Arabico attraverso lo stretto Stretto di Hormuz, confina con otto nazioni inclusi Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Arabia Saudita, Bahrain, Qatar, Emirati Arabi Uniti e Oman, controllando collettivamente quasi il 40% delle riserve petrolifere accertate del mondo. Le acque calde e saline del Golfo supportano diversi ecosistemi marini inclusi barriere coralline, praterie di alghe marine e habitat critici per specie in pericolo come la tartaruga embricata e il dugongo, mentre le sue coste hanno assistito al sorgere di antiche civiltà e moderne megacittà petrolchimiche. Nonostante affronti sfide ambientali da fuoriuscite di petrolio, inquinamento industriale e cambiamenti climatici, il Golfo Persico rimane un'arteria vitale per il commercio internazionale, con oltre 17 milioni di barili di petrolio che passano attraverso lo Stretto di Hormuz quotidianamente, rendendolo probabilmente il punto di strozzatura energetica più importante del mondo.
validation.zho: 波斯湾在阿拉伯半岛和伊朗之间延伸约990公里，是世界上最具战略重要性的水道之一，也是全球能源贸易的中心。这个浅水边缘海通过狭窄的霍尔木兹海峡与阿拉伯海相连，与包括伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、沙特阿拉伯、巴林、卡塔尔、阿联酋和阿曼在内的八个国家接壤，共同控制着世界近40%的已探明石油储量。海湾温暖的盐水支持着多样化的海洋生态系统，包括珊瑚礁、海草床以及玳瑁海龟和儒艮等濒危物种的重要栖息地，而其海岸线见证了古代文明和现代石化巨型城市的兴起。尽管面临石油泄漏、工业污染和气候变化带来的环境挑战，波斯湾仍然是国际贸易的重要动脉，每天有超过1700万桶石油通过霍尔木兹海峡，使其成为世界上最重要的能源咽喉要道。

validation.explanation: Iconic 1972 crime film directed by Francis Ford Coppola, widely regarded as one of cinema's greatest achievements
validation.en: The Godfather, directed by Francis Ford Coppola and released in 1972, stands as cinema's most influential crime epic and a masterpiece that revolutionized Hollywood filmmaking. Based on Mario Puzo's bestselling novel, the film chronicles the powerful Corleone crime family through the transformation of Michael Corleone from reluctant outsider to ruthless don, portrayed with legendary intensity by Al Pacino alongside Marlon Brando's iconic performance as Vito Corleone. The movie's meticulous attention to detail, from Gordon Willis's shadowy cinematography to Nino Rota's haunting score, created an authentic portrait of organized crime that transcended the gangster genre to become a profound meditation on power, family loyalty, and the corruption of the American Dream. Winning three Academy Awards including Best Picture and spawning two equally acclaimed sequels, The Godfather trilogy established new standards for cinematic storytelling and remains a cultural touchstone whose quotes, scenes, and themes continue to influence filmmakers and audiences worldwide.

Winning మూడు Academy Awards including Best Picture మరియు spawning రెండు equally acclaimed sequels, The Godfather trilogy established కొత్త standards cinematic storytelling కొరకు మరియు remains ఒక cultural touchstone దీని quotes, scenes, మరియు themes continue చేస్తాయి filmmakers మరియు audiences ను worldwide influence చేయడం.
validation.en-swa: The Godfather, directed na Francis Ford Coppola na released mwaka 1972, stands kama crime epic yenye ushawishi mkubwa zaidi wa sinema na masterpiece ambayo ilirevolutionized utengenezaji wa filamu za Hollywood. Based kwenye riwaya ya Mario Puzo iliyouzwa sana, filamu hii chronicles familia yenye nguvu ya uhalifu ya Corleone kupitia mabadiliko ya Michael Corleone kutoka kwa reluctant outsider hadi ruthless don, akiigizwa kwa legendary intensity na Al Pacino pamoja na iconic performance ya Marlon Brando kama Vito Corleone. The movie's makini attention kwa detail, kutoka shadowy cinematography ya Gordon Willis hadi haunting score ya Nino Rota, created picha halisi ya uhalifu uliopangwa ambao ulitranscend aina ya gangster kuwa tafakari nzito juu ya nguvu, uaminifu wa kifamilia, na ufisadi wa Ndoto ya Kimarekani. Winning tuzo tatu za Academy ikiwa ni pamoja na Best Picture na spawning sequels mbili zenye sifa sawa, The Godfather trilogy established viwango vipya vya uongozaji wa hadithi za sinema na inabaki kuwa kielelezo cha kitamaduni ambayo quotes, scenes, na themes zake zinaendelea kuathiri watengenezaji wa filamu na hadhira duniani kote.
validation.fa: پدرخوانده، به کارگردانی فرانسیس فورد کوپولا و اکران در سال ۱۹۷۲، به عنوان تأثیرگذارترین حماسه جنایی سینما و شاهکاری که فیلم‌سازی هالیوود را متحول کرد، شناخته می‌شود. این فیلم که بر اساس رمان پرفروش ماریو پوزو ساخته شده است، خانواده جنایتکار قدرتمند کورلئونه را از طریق تبدیل مایکل کورلئونه از یک فرد بیرونی بی‌میل به رئیس بی‌رحم روایت می‌کند، که با شدت افسانه‌ای توسط آل پاچینو در کنار بازی نمادین مارلون براندو به عنوان ویتو کورلئونه به تصویر کشیده شده است. توجه دقیق فیلم به جزئیات، از فیلم‌برداری سایه‌دار گوردون ویلیس تا موسیقی دلهره‌آور نینو روتا، پرتره‌ای اصیل از جنایت سازمان‌یافته خلق کرد که از ژانر گانگستری فراتر رفت و به تأملی عمیق درباره قدرت، وفاداری خانوادگی و فساد رویای آمریکایی تبدیل شد. سه‌گانه پدرخوانده که سه جایزه اسکار از جمله بهترین فیلم برنده شد و دو دنباله تحسین‌شده یکسان به دنیا آورد، استانداردهای جدیدی برای داستان‌گویی سینمایی تعیین کرد و همچنان به عنوان سنگ محک فرهنگی باقی می‌ماند که نقل‌قول‌ها، صحنه‌ها و مضامین آن همچنان بر فیلم‌سازان و مخاطبان سراسر جهان تأثیر می‌گذارد.
validation.tur: Francis Ford Coppola tarafından yönetilen ve 1972'de vizyona giren Baba, sinemanın en etkili suç destanı ve Hollywood film yapımcılığını devrimleştiren bir başyapıt olarak durmaktadır. Mario Puzo'nun çok satan romanından uyarlanan film, güçlü Corleone suç ailesi aracılığıyla Michael Corleone'nin isteksiz dışarıdan biri olmaktan acımasız don olmaya dönüşümünü anlatır, Al Pacino tarafından efsanevi yoğunlukla canlandırılır ve Marlon Brando'nun Vito Corleone olarak ikonik performansı eşlik eder. Gordon Willis'in gölgeli sinematografisinden Nino Rota'nın unutulmaz müziğine kadar filmin ayrıntılara titiz dikkat göstermesi, gangster türünü aşarak güç, aile sadakati ve Amerikan Rüyası'nın yozlaşması üzerine derin bir meditasyon haline gelen organize suçun otantik bir portresini yaratmıştır. En İyi Film dahil üç Akademi Ödülü kazanan ve eşit derecede beğenilen iki devam filmi yaratan Baba üçlemesi, sinematik hikaye anlatımı için yeni standartlar belirlemiş ve alıntıları, sahneleri ve temaları dünya çapında film yapımcılarını ve izleyicileri etkilemeye devam eden kültürel bir dönüm noktası olmaya devam etmektedir.
validation.ita: Il Padrino, diretto da Francis Ford Coppola e rilasciato nel 1972, si erge come l'epico criminale più influente del cinema e un capolavoro che rivoluzionò la produzione cinematografica di Hollywood. Basato sul romanzo bestseller di Mario Puzo, il film racconta la potente famiglia criminale Corleone attraverso la trasformazione di Michael Corleone da outsider riluttante a don spietato, interpretato con intensità leggendaria da Al Pacino insieme alla performance iconica di Marlon Brando come Vito Corleone. L'attenzione meticolosa del film ai dettagli, dalla cinematografia ombrosa di Gordon Willis alla colonna sonora ossessionante di Nino Rota, creò un ritratto autentico del crimine organizzato che trascese il genere gangster per diventare una profonda meditazione sul potere, la lealtà familiare e la corruzione del Sogno Americano. Vincendo tre Academy Awards incluso Miglior Film e generando due sequel ugualmente acclamati, la trilogia de Il Padrino stabilì nuovi standard per la narrazione cinematografica e rimane una pietra di paragone culturale le cui citazioni, scene e temi continuano a influenzare registi e pubblico in tutto il mondo.
validation.zho: 由弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉执导并于1972年上映的《教父》是电影史上最具影响力的犯罪史诗，也是革命了好莱坞电影制作的杰作。该片改编自马里奥·普佐的畅销小说，通过迈克尔·科莱昂从不情愿的局外人转变为无情教父的故事，展现了强大的科莱昂犯罪家族，阿尔·帕西诺以传奇般的强度刻画了这个角色，马龙·白兰度则以标志性的表演饰演维托·科莱昂。从戈登·威利斯阴暗的摄影到尼诺·罗塔令人难忘的配乐，电影对细节的精细关注创造了有组织犯罪的真实写照，超越了黑帮类型片，成为对权力、家族忠诚和美国梦腐败的深刻冥想。该片获得包括最佳影片在内的三项奥斯卡奖，并产生了两部同样备受赞誉的续集，《教父》三部曲为电影叙事建立了新标准，至今仍是文化试金石，其台词、场景和主题继续影响着世界各地的电影制作者和观众。

validation.explanation: The world's second-largest ocean, crucial for global climate, trade, and historical connections between continents
validation.en: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching over 106 million square kilometers between the Americas and Europe-Africa, serves as the world's second-largest ocean and a crucial corridor that has shaped human civilization for millennia. This vast body of water, divided into North and South Atlantic basins by the equatorial counter-current, plays a fundamental role in global climate regulation through the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, which transports warm tropical waters northward and cold polar waters southward. The ocean's Mid-Atlantic Ridge, an underwater mountain range running from Iceland to Antarctica, marks the boundary between tectonic plates and continues to widen the Atlantic by approximately 2.5 centimeters annually. Throughout history, the Atlantic has been humanity's highway for exploration, colonization, and trade, witnessing everything from Viking expeditions and the Age of Discovery to the tragic sinking of the Titanic and modern transatlantic commerce that carries billions of dollars in goods annually between continents.

This vast body воды, divided на North и South Atlantic basins экваториальным counter-current, plays fundamental role в global climate regulation через Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, которая transports теплые tropical waters на север и cold polar waters на юг. The ocean's Mid-Atlantic Ridge, подводный mountain range running от Iceland до Antarctica, marks границу между tectonic plates и continues расширять Atlantic примерно на 2.5 сантиметра annually. Throughout истории, Atlantic был humanity's highway для exploration, colonization, и trade, witnessing всё от Viking expeditions и Age of Discovery до tragic sinking Titanic и modern transatlantic commerce которая carries миллиарды долларов товаров annually между continents.

validation.en-tha: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching กว่า 106 ล้านตารางกิโลเมตร between ทวีปอเมริกาและยุโรป-แอฟริกา, serves เป็นมหาสมุทรที่ใหญ่เป็นอันดับสองของโลกและ crucial corridor ที่ shaped อารยธรรมมนุษย์มานานหลายพันปี. This vast body ของน้ำ, divided เป็นอ่าว North และ South Atlantic โดย equatorial counter-current, plays บทบาท fundamental ใน global climate regulation ผ่าน Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation ซึ่ง transports น้ำ tropical อุ่นไปทางเหนือและ cold polar waters ไปทางใต้. The ocean's Mid-Atlantic Ridge สันเขาใต้น้ำที่ running จากไอซ์แลนด์ไปยังแอนตาร์กติกา, marks ขอบเขตระหว่าง tectonic plates และ continues ขยาย Atlantic ประมาณ 2.5 เซนติเมตรต่อปี. Throughout ประวัติศาสตร์ Atlantic เป็น highway ของมนุษยชาติสำหรับ exploration, colonization และ trade, witnessing ทุกอย่างตั้งแต่ Viking expeditions และ Age of Discovery ไปจนถึง tragic sinking ของไททานิคและ modern transatlantic commerce ที่ carries สินค้ามูลค่าหลายพันล้านดอลลาร์ annually ระหว่าง continents.
validation.en-arb: The Atlantic Ocean، stretching أكثر من 106 مليون كيلومتر مربع between الأمريكتين وأوروبا-أفريقيا، serves كثاني أكبر محيط في العالم و crucial corridor الذي shaped الحضارة البشرية لآلاف السنين. This vast body من المياه، divided إلى أحواض شمال وجنوب الأطلسي بواسطة التيار المضاد الاستوائي، plays دوراً أساسياً في تنظيم المناخ العالمي من خلال الدورة الانقلابية الزوالية الأطلسية، التي transports المياه الاستوائية الدافئة شمالاً والمياه القطبية الباردة جنوباً. The ocean's سلسلة جبال وسط الأطلسي، سلسلة جبال تحت الماء running من أيسلندا إلى أنتاركتيكا، marks الحدود بين الصفائح التكتونية و continues توسيع الأطلسي بحوالي 2.5 سنتيمتر سنوياً. Throughout التاريخ، كان الأطلسي طريق البشرية السريع للاستكشاف والاستعمار والتجارة، witnessing كل شيء من رحلات الفايكنغ وعصر الاكتشاف إلى الغرق المأساوي لتايتانيك والتجارة عبر الأطلسي الحديثة التي تحمل مليارات الدولارات من البضائع سنوياً بين القارات.
validation.en-tur: The Atlantic Ocean, 106 milyon kilometrekareden fazla stretching Amerikalar ile Avrupa-Afrika arasında, serves dünyanın ikinci en büyük okyanusu ve millennia boyunca insan medeniyetini shaped eden crucial corridor olarak. This vast su kütlesi, ekvator karşı akımı tarafından Kuzey ve Güney Atlantik havzalarına divided, global iklim düzenlemesinde fundamental role plays ediyor Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation aracılığıyla, bu sıcak tropikal suları kuzeye ve soğuk kutup sularını güneye transports ediyor. The ocean's Orta Atlantik Sırtı, İzlanda'dan Antarktika'ya kadar running underwater dağ silsilesi, tektonik plakalar arasındaki sınırı marks ediyor ve Atlantik'i yılda yaklaşık 2.5 santimetre continues genişletiyor. Throughout tarih boyunca, Atlantik insanlığın keşif, sömürgecilik ve ticaret için highway'i oldu, Viking seferlerinden ve Keşifler Çağı'ndan Titanik'in trajik batışına ve kıtalar arasında yılda milyarlarca dolarlık mal carries eden modern transatlantik ticarete kadar her şeyi witnessing etti.
validation.en-kor: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching 106백만 평방킬로미터 이상 between 아메리카 대륙과 유럽-아프리카, serves 세계에서 두 번째로 큰 ocean으로 그리고 millennia 동안 인간 civilization을 shaped해온 crucial corridor로. This vast body 물의, divided 적도 반류에 의해 North와 South Atlantic 분지로, plays global climate regulation에서 fundamental role을 Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation을 통해, 이것이 transports warm tropical waters를 북쪽으로 그리고 cold polar waters를 남쪽으로. The ocean's Mid-Atlantic Ridge, 아이슬란드에서 남극까지 running하는 underwater mountain range, marks tectonic plates 사이의 경계를 그리고 continues Atlantic을 연간 약 2.5센티미터씩 확장시키고 있다. Throughout 역사를 통해, Atlantic은 humanity의 exploration, colonization, 그리고 trade를 위한 highway였으며, witnessing Viking expeditions와 Age of Discovery부터 Titanic의 tragic sinking과 continents 사이에서 연간 수십억 달러의 goods를 carries하는 modern transatlantic commerce까지 모든 것을.
validation.en-hin: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching 106 मिलियन वर्ग किलोमीटर से अधिक between Americas और Europe-Africa, serves दुनिया के दूसरे सबसे बड़े ocean के रूप में और crucial corridor जिसने millennia तक human civilization को shaped किया है। This vast body पानी का, divided North और South Atlantic basins में equatorial counter-current द्वारा, plays fundamental role global climate regulation में Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation के through, जो transports करता है warm tropical waters को उत्तर की ओर और cold polar waters को दक्षिण की ओर। The ocean का Mid-Atlantic Ridge, एक underwater mountain range जो running है Iceland से Antarctica तक, marks करता है boundary tectonic plates के बीच और continues Atlantic को लगभग 2.5 सेंटीमीटर annually expand करना। Throughout इतिहास में, Atlantic रहा है humanity का highway exploration, colonization, और trade के लिए, witnessing करते हुए सब कुछ Viking expeditions और Age of Discovery से लेकर Titanic के tragic sinking और modern transatlantic commerce तक जो carries करता है billions डॉलर के goods annually continents के बीच।
validation.en-ben: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching 106 মিলিয়ন বর্গকিলোমিটারের বেশি between আমেরিকা এবং ইউরোপ-আফ্রিকা, serves বিশ্বের দ্বিতীয় বৃহত্তম ocean হিসেবে এবং crucial corridor যা millennia ধরে human civilization কে shaped করেছে। This vast body জলের, divided উত্তর এবং দক্ষিণ আটলান্টিক অববাহিকায় equatorial counter-current দ্বারা, plays fundamental role global climate regulation এ Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation এর through, যা transports করে warm tropical waters উত্তরে এবং cold polar waters দক্ষিণে। The ocean এর Mid-Atlantic Ridge, একটি underwater mountain range যা running আইসল্যান্ড থেকে অ্যান্টার্কটিকা পর্যন্ত, marks করে boundary tectonic plates এর মধ্যে এবং continues Atlantic কে প্রতি বছর প্রায় 2.5 সেন্টিমিটার expand করতে। Throughout ইতিহাসে, Atlantic ছিল humanity এর highway exploration, colonization, এবং trade এর জন্য, witnessing করে সবকিছু Viking expeditions এবং Age of Discovery থেকে Titanic এর tragic sinking এবং modern transatlantic commerce যা carries করে billions ডলারের goods annually continents এর মধ্যে।
validation.en-tel: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching 106 మిలియన్ చదరపు కిలోమీటర్లకు మించి between అమెరికాలు మరియు యూరోప్-ఆఫ్రికా, serves ప్రపంచంలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద ocean గా మరియు crucial corridor గా ఇది millennia పాటు human civilization ను shaped చేసింది. This vast body నీటి, divided ఉత్తర మరియు దక్షిణ అట్లాంటిక్ basins లోకి equatorial counter-current చేత, plays fundamental role global climate regulation లో Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation ద్వారా, ఇది transports చేస్తుంది warm tropical waters ను ఉత్తరానికి మరియు cold polar waters ను దక్షిణానికి. The ocean యొక్క Mid-Atlantic Ridge, ఒక underwater mountain range ఇది running ఐస్లాండ్ నుండి అంటార్కటికా వరకు, marks చేస్తుంది boundary tectonic plates మధ్య మరియు continues Atlantic ను సంవత్సరానికి సుమారు 2.5 సెంటీమీటర్లు విస్తరించడం. Throughout చరిత్రలో, Atlantic అయ్యింది humanity యొక్క highway exploration, colonization, మరియు trade కొరకు, witnessing చేస్తూ అన్నిటినీ Viking expeditions మరియు Age of Discovery నుండి Titanic యొక్క tragic sinking మరియు modern transatlantic commerce వరకు ఇది carries చేస్తుంది billions డాలర్ల goods ను annually continents మధ్య.
validation.en-swa: The Atlantic Ocean, stretching zaidi ya kilomita za mraba milioni 106 kati ya Amerika na Ulaya-Afrika, serves kama bahari ya pili kubwa zaidi duniani na njia muhimu ambayo imesaidia kuunda utamaduni wa kibinadamu kwa maelfu ya miaka. This mwanga mkubwa wa maji, umegawanywa katika mabwawa ya Kaskazini na Kusini mwa Atlantic na mkondo wa equatorial counter-current, inacheza jukumu la msingi katika udhibiti wa hali ya hewa duniani kupitia Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, ambayo inasafirisha maji ya joto ya kitropiki kaskazini na maji baridi ya polar kusini. The ocean's Mid-Atlantic Ridge, mlolongo wa milima chini ya maji ukipita kutoka Iceland hadi Antarctica, unaonyesha mpaka kati ya sahani za tectonic na unaendelea kupanua Atlantic kwa takriban sentimita 2.5 kila mwaka. Katika historia yote, Atlantic imekuwa njia kuu ya binadamu kwa uchunguzi, ukoloni, na biashara, ikishuhudia kila kitu kutoka safari za Viking na Zama za Ugunduzi hadi kuzama kwa huzuni kwa Titanic na biashara ya kisasa ya transatlantic ambayo inabeba mabilioni ya dola za bidhaa kila mwaka kati ya mabara.
validation.fa: اقیانوس اطلس، که بیش از ۱۰۶ میلیون کیلومتر مربع بین قاره‌های آمریکا و اروپا-آفریقا کشیده شده است، به عنوان دومین اقیانوس بزرگ جهان و راهروی حیاتی که هزاران سال تمدن بشری را شکل داده است، عمل می‌کند. این حجم عظیم آب، که توسط جریان مخالف استوایی به حوضه‌های شمال و جنوب اطلس تقسیم می‌شود، نقش بنیادی در تنظیم آب و هوای جهانی از طریق گردش واژگونی نصف‌النهاری اطلس ایفا می‌کند که آب‌های گرم استوایی را به سمت شمال و آب‌های سرد قطبی را به سمت جنوب حمل می‌کند. ریج میانه اطلس، رشته کوه زیردریایی که از ایسلند تا قطب جنوب امتداد دارد، مرز بین صفحات تکتونیکی را مشخص می‌کند و همچنان اطلس را تقریباً ۲.۵ سانتی‌متر سالانه گسترش می‌دهد. در طول تاریخ، اطلس بزرگراه بشریت برای اکتشاف، استعمار و تجارت بوده است و شاهد همه چیز از اکسپدیشن‌های وایکینگ و عصر کشف تا غرق غم‌انگیز تایتانیک و تجارت مدرن ترانس‌اتلانتیک که سالانه میلیاردها دلار کالا بین قاره‌ها حمل می‌کند، بوده است.
validation.tur: Amerika ile Avrupa-Afrika arasında 106 milyon kilometrekareden fazla alan kaplayan Atlantik Okyanusu, dünyanın ikinci en büyük okyanusu ve binlerce yıldır insanlık medeniyetini şekillendiren önemli bir koridor olarak hizmet etmektedir. Ekvator karşı akıntısı tarafından Kuzey ve Güney Atlantik havzalarına bölünen bu geniş su kütlesi, sıcak tropik suları kuzeye ve soğuk kutup sularını güneye taşıyan Atlantik Meridyonal Devrilme Dolaşımı aracılığıyla küresel iklim düzenlemesinde temel rol oynamaktadır. Okyanusun İzlanda'dan Antarktika'ya kadar uzanan sualtı dağ sırası olan Orta Atlantik Sırtı, tektonik plakalar arasındaki sınırı işaretler ve Atlantik'i yılda yaklaşık 2,5 santimetre genişletmeye devam etmektedir. Tarih boyunca Atlantik, keşif, kolonileştirme ve ticaret için insanlığın ana yolu olmuş, Viking seferlerinden ve Keşifler Çağı'ndan Titanik'in trajik batışına ve kıtalar arası yılda milyarlarca dolarlık mal taşıyan modern transatlantik ticaretine kadar her şeye tanık olmuştur.
validation.ita: L'Oceano Atlantico, che si estende per oltre 106 milioni di chilometri quadrati tra le Americhe e l'Europa-Africa, serve come il secondo oceano più grande del mondo e un corridoio cruciale che ha plasmato la civiltà umana per millenni. Questa vasta massa d'acqua, divisa nei bacini dell'Atlantico Nord e Sud dalla controcorrente equatoriale, svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella regolazione climatica globale attraverso la Circolazione di Ribaltamento Meridionale Atlantica, che trasporta le acque tropicali calde verso nord e le acque polari fredde verso sud. La Dorsale Medio-Atlantica dell'oceano, una catena montuosa sottomarina che va dall'Islanda all'Antartide, segna il confine tra le placche tettoniche e continua ad allargare l'Atlantico di circa 2,5 centimetri annualmente. Nel corso della storia, l'Atlantico è stato l'autostrada dell'umanità per l'esplorazione, la colonizzazione e il commercio, assistendo a tutto dalle spedizioni vichinghe e l'Età delle Scoperte al tragico affondamento del Titanic e al moderno commercio transatlantico che trasporta miliardi di dollari in merci annualmente tra i continenti.
validation.zho: 大西洋在美洲与欧洲-非洲之间延伸超过1.06亿平方公里，是世界第二大洋，也是数千年来塑造人类文明的重要走廊。这片被赤道逆流分为北大西洋和南大西洋盆地的广阔水体，通过大西洋经向翻转环流在全球气候调节中发挥着根本作用，该环流将温暖的热带海水向北输送，将寒冷的极地海水向南输送。海洋的大西洋中脊是一条从冰岛延伸到南极洲的海底山脉，标志着构造板块之间的边界，并继续以每年约2.5厘米的速度扩大大西洋。纵观历史，大西洋一直是人类探索、殖民和贸易的高速公路，见证了从维京远征和大航海时代到泰坦尼克号的悲惨沉没，以及每年在各大洲之间运送数十亿美元货物的现代跨大西洋贸易的一切。
